017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views;
018
019import static java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
021
022import java.io.*;
023import java.nio.*;
024import java.nio.channels.*;
025import java.nio.file.*;
026import java.util.*;
027import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;
028import java.util.function.*;
029import java.util.logging.*;

034import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.runreport.*;

036/**
037 * A {@link RunViewSource} over one growing JSON Lines file, one event per line, paged through a
038 * {@link FileLineIndex}.
039 *
040 * <p>
041 * <b>Path safety.</b> The application supplies the {@link Path} when it builds the source; nothing in a request ever
042 * becomes a path.  An application that derives paths from ids must resolve them against a fixed root,
043 * {@code normalize()} the result, and require {@code result.startsWith(root)}.
044 *
045 * <p>
046 * <b>Numbering.</b> {@code seq} is the 1-based line number.  A {@code seq} member in the file is ignored and
047 * overwritten, so the producer writes events without one.  A line that is not valid JSON, is not a known event, or is
048 * too long is skipped: it consumes its line number, so a gap appears in {@code seq}.  The first such line a source
049 * meets is logged once as a {@code WARNING}, with its line number; later ones are skipped without a log record, so a
050 * corrupt file polled every second does not flood the log.  Blank lines are not counted as malformed.
051 *
052 * <p>
053 * <b>Tokens</b> are {@code <epoch>.<n>}: the epoch of the file generation and the last line number consumed.  A stale
054 * epoch (the file was truncated, replaced or rewritten) or an {@code n} beyond the indexed lines throws
055 * {@link RunViewSource.UnknownTokenException UnknownTokenException}.  This includes a token issued while the file did
056 * not exist yet, once the file has been created.
057 *
058 * <p>
059 * Only complete lines are read, so a partially written last line never appears.  Keep <b>one instance per file</b>;
060 * a new instance re-indexes the file from byte 0.
061 *
062 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
063 * <p class='bjava'>
064 *    FileRunViewSource <jv>src</jv> = FileRunViewSource.<jsm>create</jsm>(<jv>root</jv>.resolve(<js>"run-42.jsonl"</js>))
065 *       .terminal(() -&gt; <jv>run</jv>.isFinished())
066 *       .build();
067 * </p>
068 */
069@SuppressWarnings({
070   "java:S135", // Guard clauses keep the loop readable.
071   "java:S3776" // Validation and rendering chains many independent guards; splitting them adds no clarity.
072})
073public final class FileRunViewSource implements RunViewSource {
074
075   /** Lines longer than this many bytes are skipped without being decoded. */
076   private static final int MAX_LINE_BYTES = RunEvent.MAX_EVENT_CHARS * 4;
077   private static final Logger LOG = Logger.getLogger(FileRunViewSource.class.getName());
078
079   private static final Pattern TOKEN = Pattern.compile("^([0-9a-z]{6})\\.(0|[1-9]\\d{0,17})$");
080
081   /**
082    * Builder for {@link FileRunViewSource}.
083    */
084   public static final class Builder {
085      private final Path file;
086      private BooleanSupplier terminal = () -> false;
087      private FileLineIndex index;
088
089      Builder(Path file) {
090         this.file = Objects.requireNonNull(file, "file");
091      }
092
093      /**
094       * Sets the supplier that reports whether the producer will write no more, called once per request before the
095       * file is read.
096       *
097       * @param value The supplier.
098       * @return This object.
099       */
100      public Builder terminal(BooleanSupplier value) {
101         terminal = Objects.requireNonNull(value, "terminal");
102         return this;
103      }
104
105      /**
106       * Sets the index (default {@link FileLineIndex#of(Path)}), so one index can be shared across requests.
107       *
108       * @param value An index over the same file.
109       * @return This object.
110       */
111      public Builder index(FileLineIndex value) {
112         index = value;
113         return this;
114      }
115
116      /**
117       * Builds the source.
118       *
119       * @return A new source.
120       */
121      public FileRunViewSource build() {
122         if (index != null && ! index.file().equals(file))
123            throw iaex("FileRunViewSource index is for a different file: '%s' vs '%s'.", index.file(), file);
124         return new FileRunViewSource(this);
125      }
126   }
127
128   private final Path file;
129   private final BooleanSupplier terminal;
130   private final FileLineIndex index;
131   private final AtomicBoolean warned = new AtomicBoolean();
132
133   private FileRunViewSource(Builder b) {
134      file = b.file;
135      terminal = b.terminal;
136      index = b.index != null ? b.index : FileLineIndex.of(b.file);
137   }
138
139   /**
140    * Creates a builder.
141    *
142    * @param file The file, supplied by the application.
143    * @return A new builder.
144    */
145   public static Builder create(Path file) {
146      return new Builder(file);
147   }
148
149   @Override /* RunViewSource */
150   public RunViewPage page(String after, int max) {
151      // Read the flag first: if the producer writes its last events and flips the flag after this point, the page
152      // is simply not terminal yet and the next request sees both.
153      var done = terminal.getAsBoolean();
154      var s = refresh();
155      var n = after == null ? 0L : position(after, s);
156      if (n >= s.indexedLines())
157         return RunViewPage.of(List.of(), token(s, n), false, done);
158      var start = seek(n + 1);
159      if (start < 0)
160         throw new UnknownTokenException(after);
161      var limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(max, RunViewPage.MAX_PAGE_EVENTS));
162      var events = new ArrayList<RunEvent>();
163      var last = n;
164      try (var r = new LineReader(file, start, s.indexedBytes())) {
165         var chars = 0L;
166         var lineNo = n;
167         while (events.size() < limit) {
168            var text = r.next();
169            if (text == null)
170               break;
171            lineNo++;
172            var e = parse(text, lineNo);
173            if (e != null) {
174               var c = serializedLength(e);
175               if (! events.isEmpty() && chars + c > RunViewPage.MAX_PAGE_CHARS)
176                  break;
177               chars += c;
178               events.add(e);
179            }
180            last = lineNo;
181         }
182      } catch (IOException e) {
183         throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
184      }
185      var more = last < s.indexedLines();
186      return RunViewPage.of(events, token(s, last), more, done && ! more);
187   }
188
189   private RunEvent parse(String text, long lineNo) {
190      if (text.isEmpty())
191         return null;
192      if (text.length() > RunEvent.MAX_EVENT_CHARS)
193         return skipped(lineNo, "longer than " + RunEvent.MAX_EVENT_CHARS + " characters");
194      try {
195         return RunEvent.fromMap(Json.to(text, Map.class)).withSeq(lineNo);
196      } catch (Exception e) {
197         return skipped(lineNo, e.getMessage());
198      }
199   }
200
201   /** Logs the first skipped line of this source, and returns <jk>null</jk>. */
202   private RunEvent skipped(long lineNo, String why) {
203      if (warned.compareAndSet(false, true))
204         LOG.warning(() -> "FileRunViewSource '" + file + "' skipped malformed line " + lineNo + " (" + why
205            + "); later malformed lines in this source are skipped without a warning.");
206      return null;
207   }
208
209   private static int serializedLength(RunEvent e) {
210      return JsonSerializer.DEFAULT.toString(e.toContractMap()).length();
211   }
212
213   private FileLineIndex.Snapshot refresh() {
214      try {
215         return index.refresh();
216      } catch (IOException e) {
217         throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
218      }
219   }
220
221   private long seek(long n) {
222      try {
223         return index.seek(n);
224      } catch (IOException e) {
225         throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
226      }
227   }
228
229   private long position(String token, FileLineIndex.Snapshot s) {
230      var m = TOKEN.matcher(token);
231      if (! m.matches() || ! index.acceptsEpoch(m.group(1)))
232         throw new UnknownTokenException(token);
233      var n = Long.parseLong(m.group(2));
234      if (n > s.indexedLines())
235         throw new UnknownTokenException(token);
236      return n;
237   }
238
239   private static String token(FileLineIndex.Snapshot s, long n) {
240      return s.epoch() + "." + n;
241   }
242
243   /** Sequential reader of the complete lines in [start, end); opens the file lazily. */
244   @SuppressWarnings({
245      "resource" // The channel is opened lazily by next() and closed by close().
246   })
247   private static final class LineReader implements Closeable {
248      private final Path file;
249      private final long end;
250      private final ByteBuffer buf = ByteBuffer.allocate(FileLineIndex.BLOCK_BYTES);
251      private FileChannel ch;
252      private long pos;
253      private boolean first;
254      private boolean eof;
255
256      LineReader(Path file, long start, long end) {
257         this.file = file;
258         this.end = end;
259         pos = start;
260         first = start == 0;
261         buf.limit(0);
262      }
263
264      /** Returns the next line's text, {@code ""} for an unusable line (overlong or blank), or <jk>null</jk> at the end. */
265      String next() throws IOException {
266         if (eof || pos >= end)
267            return null;
268         if (ch == null) {
269            try {
270               ch = FileChannel.open(file, StandardOpenOption.READ);
271            } catch (NoSuchFileException e) {
272               eof = true;
273               return null;
274            }
275         }
276         var acc = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
277         var overlong = false;
278         while (pos < end) {
279            if (! buf.hasRemaining()) {
280               buf.clear();
281               if (end - pos < buf.capacity())
282                  buf.limit((int)(end - pos));
283               var r = ch.read(buf, pos);
284               buf.flip();
285               if (r <= 0) {
286                  eof = true;
287                  return null;
288               }
289            }
290            var b = buf.get();
291            pos++;
292            if (b == '\n')
293               break;
294            if (acc.size() < MAX_LINE_BYTES)
295               acc.write(b);
296            else
297               overlong = true;
298         }
299         var wasFirst = first;
300         first = false;
301         if (overlong)
302            return "";
303         var bytes = acc.toByteArray();
304         var from = wasFirst && bytes.length >= 3 && (bytes[0] & 0xFF) == 0xEF && (bytes[1] & 0xFF) == 0xBB && (bytes[2] & 0xFF) == 0xBF ? 3 : 0;
305         var len = bytes.length > from && bytes[bytes.length - 1] == '\r' ? bytes.length - 1 : bytes.length;
306         return new String(bytes, from, len - from, UTF_8);
307      }
308
309      @Override /* Closeable */
310      public void close() {
311         if (ch == null)
312            return;
313         try {
314            ch.close();
315         } catch (IOException e) {
316            // Read-only channel; nothing to recover.
317         } finally {
318            ch = null;
319         }
320      }
321   }
322}
